title: Your First Weekend at CUNY City College, Shared as Cards
description: A guide for new students to navigate their first weekend at CCNY, featuring essential campus landmarks, local history, and student life hubs.

cards.title: Move-In at The Towers
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Check into your new home at 401 West 130th Street. Use your designated time slot to unload and meet your Resident Assistant (RA) for floor orientation.
cards.short_summary: The official on-campus residence hall for CCNY students.
cards.evidence_claim: The official move-in date for Fall 2026 is Saturday, August 22, 2026, with designated time slots starting at 8:30 am.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residents and authorized guests with card-access entry.

cards.title: Lunch at the NAC Café
cards.subtitle: Saturday Midday Refuel
cards.notes: Visit the North Academic Center's main dining area for a quick meal. It is a central hub for meeting fellow new students during move-in weekend.
cards.short_summary: The primary dining facility located within the North Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The NAC Café (The Lodge) is a primary dining location on campus with ample seating in the cafeteria.
cards.source_title: Dining Services - The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open to students and staff; typical weekday hours are 8am-6pm, check for weekend orientation hours.

cards.title: Walk Through St. Nicholas Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Exploration
cards.notes: Explore the 28-acre park bordering the campus. It offers a scenic route between the campus buildings and the surrounding Harlem neighborhood.
cards.short_summary: A public park adjacent to the CCNY campus featuring historic landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Nicholas Park is a spacious park that has been a focus of community and City College 'Take Back' initiatives since 1995.
cards.source_title: St. Nicholas Park Highlights - NYC Parks
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from 6:00 am to 10:00 pm.

cards.title: Visit Alexander Hamilton's Home
cards.subtitle: Saturday Cultural Stop
cards.notes: Tour the relocated home of Alexander Hamilton. The visitor center in the basement offers free exhibits on his life and legacy in New York.
cards.short_summary: The historic home of Alexander Hamilton located within St. Nicholas Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The visitor center is open Wednesday through Sunday, 10:00 am - 5:00 pm, and admission is free.
cards.source_title: Basic Information - Hamilton Grange National Memorial
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday-Sunday; guided tours of the historic floor are free and first-come, first-served.

cards.entity_name: The Great Hall in Shepard Hall
cards.title: Admire the Great Hall
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Architecture
cards.notes: Step inside the neo-Gothic Shepard Hall to see the Great Hall. Look for the 'The Graduate' mural, which symbolizes the college's mission of wisdom.
cards.short_summary: A historic 1,520-seat theater and assembly space in Shepard Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The historic Great Hall features Edwin H. Blashfield's mural 'The Graduate' and is a centerpiece of the campus.
cards.source_title: Great Hall | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Access may be limited during private events; generally viewable during building hours.

cards.title: Get Your CCNY Gear
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Shopping
cards.notes: Pick up your official City College apparel and supplies. It's the best place to find 'Beaver' mascot merchandise before classes start.
cards.short_summary: The official university bookstore for CCNY.
cards.evidence_claim: Benny's Campus Store provides official CCNY merchandise and is located in the North Academic Center.
cards.source_title: News & Events | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Located in NAC 0/201; check website for specific weekend hours during orientation.

cards.title: Stargaze at the Planetarium
cards.subtitle: Sunday Science Experience
cards.notes: Located in the basement of the Marshak Science Building, this immersive theater hosts live space shows and tours of the universe.
cards.short_summary: An immersive science theater located in the Marshak Science Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The CCNY Planetarium hosts live space shows, often on Wednesday afternoons, but also for special orientation events.
cards.access_notes: Located in the basement of Marshak; reservations are recommended for shows.

cards.title: Connect with Student Life
cards.subtitle: Monday Morning Prep
cards.notes: Visit the Student Life office to learn about the 200+ student-run organizations and how to get involved in campus activities.
cards.short_summary: The central office for student organizations and leadership development.
cards.evidence_claim: The Department of Student Life is located in NAC 1/210 and works with over 200 student-run organizations.

cards.title: Check Out the Gym
cards.subtitle: Monday Afternoon Workout
cards.notes: Locate the fitness center in Wingate Hall. It features cardio equipment, free weights, and an indoor track for student use.
cards.short_summary: The primary fitness and recreation facility for the CCNY community.
cards.evidence_claim: Wingate Fitness Center is located on the 3rd floor of Wingate Hall and is open to all members of the City College community.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid CCNY ID; typically closed on weekends, reopening Monday morning.

cards.title: Relax on the Quad
cards.subtitle: Monday Evening Wind Down
cards.notes: Find a spot on the grass in the central Quad. It's a prime location for studying outdoors or meeting friends between classes.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor gathering space on the CCNY campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quad is a featured stop on campus tours and serves as a central gathering point for students.
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space accessible to the public and students.
